title: Revisiting Episode 16: Thinking on Designing Spaces (and changing your mind!)
summary: A replay of an early episode where Divya works through her resistance to designing the spaces she lives in. With Kahran's help she reframes a home not as aesthetic vs functional, but as a place that shapes which behaviors get cultivated — flute practice happens when the flute is on the counter, conversation happens when there's somewhere to sit. They detour into 'wakht', the breath of a space, and how to develop heuristics rather than recipes for design.
